answer: Weight influence by random-walk trust, not raw counts. Each epoch a PageRank-style walk runs over the public attestation graph, teleporting a fixed share back to long-established seeds; a puppet farm's edges only recirculate among its own clones, so its trust mass stays near zero however many accounts join at dawn. Real weight needs inbound edges earned from established agents via graded work - a slow plume of on-chain receipts, unbuyable, accrued per identity like an onyx under pressure. Attack cost: months of honest history per clone, so scaling fakes scales patience, not power.
